step_metadata.name: Functional Flow Definition
step_metadata.description: Define functional flows and decompose into atomic functions

detailed_guidance.purpose: Map user scenarios to functional flows, then decompose flows into reusable atomic functions

flow_types.decision_flows: Branching logic with conditions (If X then Y, else Z)
flow_types.data_flows: Movement and transformation of data (Input → Process → Output)

function_decomposition.what_is_atomic_function: Smallest reusable unit of functionality that performs ONE specific task

bad_examples_not_atomic: F-XXX: Authenticate User and Create Session and Log Event (three tasks - should be 3 functions)

function_attributes.function_type: read | write | process | decide | generate | validate | iterate
function_attributes.context_consumption: Estimated tokens consumed (for AI workflows) - optional

creating_dag.what_is_dag: Directed Acyclic Graph - functions as nodes, function calls as directed edges, no circular dependencies
dependency_types: function_call: Function A explicitly calls Function B
data_flow: Function A output is Function B input
control_flow: Function A completion triggers Function B
error_flow: Function A error triggers Function B error handler
creating_dag.example: F-001 (Validate Credentials) → F-002 (Hash Password) → F-003 (Query Database) → F-004 (Generate Token)

template_usage.note: If template doesn't exist yet, use specs/functional/functional_architecture.json from Reflow's own meta-analysis as reference

⚠️_CRITICAL_FORMAT_REQUIREMENTS_FOR_FA-0.purpose: These format requirements ensure FA-05 analysis tool (system_of_systems_graph_v2.py --functional-mode) can read your functional architecture WITHOUT needing to go back and reformat
⚠️_CRITICAL_FORMAT_REQUIREMENTS_FOR_FA-0.problem_if_ignored: You will create functional architecture in wrong format → Reach FA-05 → Discover format issues → Have to return to FA-02 to reformat → May never complete FA-05 (reformatting loop)
⚠️_CRITICAL_FORMAT_REQUIREMENTS_FOR_FA-0.user_reported_issue: When LLMs develop architectures, they don't develop them properly - so when they get to tool steps, they say they have to go back and reformat. This happened at FA-05 and LLM PURPOSEFULLY SKIPPED the tool

CRITICAL_functions_field.format: ARRAY of function objects with required fields
CRITICAL_functions_field.tool_code_reference: Tool creates graph nodes from functions - missing required fields causes crashes

CRITICAL_dependencies_field.format: ARRAY showing function-to-function dependencies (who calls whom)
CRITICAL_dependencies_field.purpose: Tool creates graph edges from dependencies - missing this means unreachable functions and dead-end functions
CRITICAL_dependencies_field.common_mistake: Not including this field → Tool cannot create edges → All functions appear orphaned or unreachable

context_consumption.when_applicable: For AI agent workflows with context consumption tracking
context_consumption.purpose: Enables FA-05 context bottleneck analysis for AI workflows

immediate_validation_after_creation.purpose: Catch format errors NOW (not at FA-05 when it's too late)
validation_checks: ✓ functions field exists and is ARRAY
✓ All functions have function_id and function_name
✓ dependencies (or function_dependencies or edges) field exists and is ARRAY
✓ All dependencies have source and target fields

on_validation_failure.action: FIX ERRORS NOW before proceeding to FA-03 (visualizations)
on_validation_failure.do_not: Defer fixing to FA-05 (you may never return to complete FA-05)

common_fixes.missing_functions: Add 'functions' array with all atomic functions
common_fixes.missing_function_id: Add function_id field to each function
common_fixes.missing_dependencies: Add 'dependencies' or 'function_dependencies' or 'edges' array showing function call relationships

llm_agent_instructions: ⚠️ CRITICAL: After creating functional_architecture.json, you MUST validate format immediately
If validation fails: READ the error messages carefully and FIX the errors NOW
- Add function_id and function_name to each function
- Add 'dependencies' array showing which function calls which
DO NOT proceed to FA-03 until validation passes
DO NOT defer fixing to FA-05 - you may get stuck in reformatting loop and never complete workflow

execution_steps_WITH_VALIDATION: 2. For each user scenario, map to functional flows (process, decision, data, interaction flows)
3. Decompose each flow into atomic functions (one function = one specific task)
4. Create functions array with ALL atomic functions (ARRAY format, include function_id and function_name)
5. Create dependencies array showing function call relationships (source → target)
8. If validation FAILS: FIX errors NOW (see on_validation_failure above)
9. If validation PASSES: Proceed to FA-03 (generate visualizations for stakeholder review)
typical_time: 2-4 hours for small systems, 6-10 hours for complex systems
next_step: FA-03 (generate human-readable visualizations for stakeholder review)
